x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description: This script does the following 1. Moves records from sn_cmp_azure_ea_credential table to ea_azure_credentials table 2. Marks sn_cmp_azure_ea_credential table as "Deprecated" 3. Updates EA credentials on the billing schedule from the new table 4. Updates the Interceptor so that the user will be taken to the new credentials table on trying to create new azure credentials
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Migrate Azure EA Credentials
